source.author: verg
source.text: tu regere imperio populos, Romane, memento; hae tibi erunt artes; pacisque imponere morem, parcere subiectis, et debellare superbos.
source.text_original: tu regere imperio populos, Romane, memento; / hae tibi erunt artes; pacisque imponere morem, / parcere subiectis, et debellare superbos.'
source.text_english: You, Roman, remember to rule the peoples with your power; these will be your arts: to establish the custom of peace, to spare the conquered, and to subdue the proud.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: arbiter ipse locos terrenaque summa movendo experiar, quaenam populis longissima cunctis regna velim linquamque datas ubi certus habenas.
reuse.text_original: arbiter ipse locos terrenaque summa movendo / experiar, quaenam populis longissima cunctis / regna velim linquamque datas ubi certus habenas.
reuse.text_english: I myself will try out the sites and the highest things of the earth by setting them in motion, so as to see which kingdoms I would want longest for all peoples, and where, once I am certain, I shall leave the reins that have been given me.
